strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗工厂！{SCROLL}在这里向您介绍单人玩的{NEWLINE}单人战和双打！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Factory!{SCROLL}I am your guide to the Single and{NEWLINE}Double Battle challenges.{SCROLL}Please be aware that these challenges{NEWLINE}are designed for a single Trainer.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 挑战哪一种呢？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Which challenge would{NEWLINE}you like to take? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 在这个战斗工厂{NEWLINE}使用出租的精灵们进行战斗,{CLEAR}看能够走到哪一步。{SCROLL}借来的精灵如果打赢了的话{NEWLINE}就可以和对手进行一次{NEWLINE}精灵交换！{SCROLL}５０级别上是{NEWLINE}从技能较弱的精灵开始。{SCROLL}自由级别则从能够使用{NEWLINE}较强技能的１００级的{CLEAR}精灵可以开始租借！{SCROLL}成功取得７连胜之后{NEWLINE}将获赠ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}不过,如果想临时中断挑战,{SCROLL}请保存好记录,{NEWLINE}不然是不能接着中断的{NEWLINE}地方继续玩的！{SCROLL}请一定要注意！{SCROLL}
strings.en: At the Battle Factory, you{NEWLINE}battle with rental Pokémon{CLEAR}and see how far you can go.{SCROLL}Each time you win with your rental{NEWLINE}Pokémon, you can trade one of{CLEAR}them for one of your opponent’s!{SCROLL}In the Level 50 class, you start with{NEWLINE}Pokémon that have weaker moves.{SCROLL}In the Open Level class, you{NEWLINE}can rent Level 100 Pokémon with{CLEAR}stronger moves from the start!{SCROLL}Win 7 battles in a row to earn BP!{SCROLL}If you want to take a{NEWLINE}break from your challenge,{SCROLL}be sure to save, or you won’t be{NEWLINE}able to pick up where you left off!{SCROLL}Please keep that in mind!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗工厂！{SCROLL}这里向您介绍可以和{NEWLINE}朋友一起玩的多人战！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Factory!{SCROLL}I am your guide to the Multi{NEWLINE}Battle challenge, which you can{CLEAR}take on with a friend!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0107/3 | RV043: meaning: zh 'can play with a friend', not 'requires two Trainers'

strings.zh: 要挑战战斗工厂的多人战吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Would you like to take the Battle{NEWLINE}Factory Multi Battle challenge? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这里可以使用租借的精灵{CLEAR}进行多人战。{SCROLL}首先请先借用{NEWLINE}２只精灵！{SCROLL}然后用那边的精灵{NEWLINE}进行多人战！{SCROLL}如果战斗胜利的话就可以{NEWLINE}和对手进行一次精灵交易！{SCROLL}能够进行交易的是自己{NEWLINE}或者朋友的其中一方。{SCROLL}重复战胜和交易这个过程,{NEWLINE}如果达成了７连胜的话{CLEAR}将获赠ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}５０级别上{NEWLINE}从技能较弱的精灵开始。{SCROLL}自由级别则从能够使用{NEWLINE}较强技能的１００级的{CLEAR}精灵可以开始租用。{NEWLINE}另外,战斗工厂多人战{SCROLL}不能临时中断挑战！{NEWLINE}
strings.en: Here you can take on Multi{NEWLINE}Battles with rental Pokémon.{SCROLL}First, please rent 2 Pokémon!{SCROLL}Then use them to fight Multi Battles!{SCROLL}Each time you win, you can trade{NEWLINE}Pokémon with your opponent once!{SCROLL}Only one of you, you or your{NEWLINE}friend, can make the trade.{SCROLL}Keep winning and trading, and if{NEWLINE}you win 7 in a row, you’ll earn BP!{SCROLL}In the Level 50 class, you start with{NEWLINE}Pokémon that have weaker moves.{SCROLL}In the Open Level class, you{NEWLINE}can rent Level 100 Pokémon with{CLEAR}stronger moves from the start.{SCROLL}Also, a Battle Factory Multi Battle{NEWLINE}challenge can’t be interrupted!{NEWLINE}

strings.zh: 那么,恭候您的再次光临！
strings.en: We look forward to your next visit!

strings.zh: 要挑战５０级别和{NEWLINE}自由级别中的哪一项？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Which will you challenge: the{NEWLINE}Level 50 or the Open Level class?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 在这之前进行进度的保存{NEWLINE}可以吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Your progress must be{NEWLINE}saved first. Is that OK?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好啦,请到这边来！
strings.en: Right this way, please!

strings.zh: 那么,恭候您的再次光临！{SCROLL}
strings.en: We look forward to your next visit!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 已经等您好久了！{SCROLL}在重开挑战之前保存进度！
strings.en: We’ve missed you!{SCROLL}You must save the game before you{NEWLINE}resume your challenge. Please wait.

strings.zh: 这位客人！！{SCROLL}上次没有保存好进度{NEWLINE}就结束挑战了吧！{SCROLL}上次的挑战变成无效的了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Excuse me!{SCROLL}You didn’t save before you quit your{NEWLINE}challenge last time.{SCROLL}Because of that, you have been{NEWLINE}disqualified from your challenge!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 恭喜您了！{SCROLL}您将获赠纪念照片作为奖赏！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Congratulations!{SCROLL}In recognition of your victory, we{NEWLINE}present you this commemorative print!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}把金印花{CLEAR}放进了战斗记录器！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Gold Print was added to{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}’s Vs. Recorder!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}把银印花{CLEAR}放进了战斗记录器！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Silver Print was added to{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}’s Vs. Recorder!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 两人中的一人{NEWLINE}请选择“作为领队”{SCROLL}另一人请选择“加入小组”。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: One Trainer should select{NEWLINE}“BECOME LEADER.”{SCROLL}The other Trainer must select{NEWLINE}“JOIN GROUP.” {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 在我介绍情况之前保存进度！
strings.en: You must save the{NEWLINE}game before I explain!

strings.zh: 工作人员会在这为我们{NEWLINE}介绍下一位{CLEAR}上场的训练家的信息。{SCROLL}那些说明{NEWLINE}将会非常有用！
strings.en: The staff here tell us about the next{NEWLINE}Trainer who’ll come out.{SCROLL}That information will be really useful!
strings.notes: US 0107/27 | RV043: addition: dropped US 'Don't you think?'

strings.zh: 为我们介绍下一位{NEWLINE}上场的训练家的信息？{CLEAR}我喜欢这话！{SCROLL}只要我们摸清了{NEWLINE}那位训练家的底细,{CLEAR}就能制定出各种对策。
strings.en: They tell you about the next Trainer{NEWLINE}you’ll face? That’s really nice.{SCROLL}You know, you can prepare for it{NEWLINE}once you know what kind of Trainer{CLEAR}the next one is!

strings.zh: 如果能知晓{NEWLINE}对方训练家{CLEAR}带着哪几只精灵,{CLEAR}会使用哪几种技能,{CLEAR}那这将在我们选取精灵时{CLEAR}提供巨大的方便！
strings.en: Knowing which Pokémon the other Trainer{NEWLINE}has and which moves they use makes{CLEAR}choosing our Pokémon much easier!
strings.notes: US 0107/29 | RV043: meaning: knowing in advance, not remembering (D-1702)

strings.zh: 这里不是能租借精灵{NEWLINE}和别人进行对战么？{SCROLL}那也就是说{NEWLINE}这将是我们{CLEAR}尝试新精灵的好机会,{SCROLL}它可以让我们在实际战斗中{NEWLINE}增加对精灵的了解。{SCROLL}这世界上{NEWLINE}怎么会有这么好的地方！
strings.en: This place lets you battle with rental{NEWLINE}Pokémon, right?{SCROLL}That means it’s a great chance for us{NEWLINE}to try out new Pokémon,{SCROLL}and it lets us learn more about them in{NEWLINE}real battles.{SCROLL}How can there be such a great place in{NEWLINE}this world!
strings.notes: US 0107/30 | RV043: meaning: stale US paraphrase; restored closing exclamation

strings.zh: 我看你带着{NEWLINE}一打以上的精灵,{SCROLL}不是我吹牛啊,{NEWLINE}其实我身上一个精灵都没有！{SCROLL}不过这没什么,{NEWLINE}因为这座{CLEAR}战斗工厂{CLEAR}向我们提供了{CLEAR}用租借来的精灵{CLEAR}进行战斗的系统！
strings.en: Looks like you’ve got more than a dozen{NEWLINE}Pokémon with you.{SCROLL}Not to brag, but I don’t have a single{NEWLINE}Pokémon on me!{SCROLL}But that’s no problem, because the{NEWLINE}Battle Factory lets us battle with{CLEAR}rental Pokémon!
strings.notes: US 0107/31 | RV043: meaning: more than a dozen vs not a single one (D-1703)

strings.zh: 我要在这{NEWLINE}去用那些{SCROLL}平时未曾{NEWLINE}接触过的精灵吗？{SCROLL}它们会听话吗？{NEWLINE}它们能和搞好关系吗？{CLEAR}说实话,我心里还真没个准谱。
strings.en: So here I’m supposed to use Pokémon{NEWLINE}I’ve never handled before?{SCROLL}Will they listen to me? Will I get along{NEWLINE}with them? To be honest, I really have{CLEAR}no idea.
strings.notes: US 0107/32 | RV043: meaning: stale US; restored 'listen to me' and honest uncertainty

strings.zh: 来到战斗前线的训练师们{NEWLINE}个个都是{CLEAR}身手矫健的高手！{SCROLL}要不是我有工作在身{NEWLINE}得在这执行巡逻任务,{SCROLL}不然,{NEWLINE}我早就和你们{CLEAR}打成一片了！
strings.en: All the Trainers who come to the{NEWLINE}Battle Frontier are agile, highly{CLEAR}skilled experts!{SCROLL}If I weren’t stuck here on patrol duty,{SCROLL}I’d have joined in with you all long ago!
strings.notes: US 0107/33 | RV043: meaning: skilled experts, not pleasant people (D-1704)
